title: Reports
description: Sales, purchases, stock and profit for any period, from the API, ready to export.

sales.name: Sales report
sales.about: What was sold in the period, by cashier, with the API's totals.

purchases.name: Purchases report
purchases.about: What was bought and received in the period (CR-018).

stock-valuation.name: Stock valuation
stock-valuation.about: Stock on hand at cost, never at price.

expiry.name: Expiry report
expiry.about: Lots expiring soon, so they sell or move before they spoil.

profit-and-loss.name: Profit and loss
profit-and-loss.about: Income, cost of sales and expenses from the ledger for the period.

emptyBody: Try a longer period or another branch.
denied: You do not have access to this report
negative: A net loss for the period
queued: The file is being prepared. It appears in report runs when it is ready.
